finalText:
**380 commits, 24 user-facing.** Draft is in [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).

Four are breaking. Expired tokens now return `401`, not `403`. The latency histogram units changed, so dashboards shift. Internal error types stopped being re-exported. The v1 export route is gone.

One feature: webhook retries with backoff.

The rest is fixes. Paginator, logging, trace ids, headers, allowlists.

Two calls to check. I read the empty-allowlist fix as deny-all, and I dated it `2026-08-29`.
